title_en: Characteristics of the Hypocrites in the Holy Qur'an - Part 1
summary: The first part of a series of lectures by Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari focusing on the characteristics and attributes of the hypocrites (al-munafiqin) as described in the Holy Qur'an.
